exact_statement: For actual finite uniform-cube Boolean signs, the following proposed all-degree reference mechanisms cannot uniformly pay cross entropy or their stated majorants by total influence. On F_r=1+A_r(chi_{123}-1), r>=4, all r+3 influences equal delta=2^-r, H/I<4, and the complete derivative row of a data coordinate has all its energy delta at residual degrees >=2, contradicting a proposed all-degree bound 2 delta^2 ln(2/delta). The normalized nonempty product-influence reference Q(S)=prod_{i in S}Inf_i/[prod_i(1+Inf_i)-1] has nonempty cross entropy X/I>=r-2r/(r+3). On even-dimensional quadratic bent signs, B/I=2 while degree-weighted atom entropy/I=n and influence-weighted normalized derivative entropy/I=n-1. More generally, for every rule selecting a complete spectral subprobability reference using only the labeled influence vector and permutation-invariant metadata, for every integer w>=2 some coordinate permutation of OR of 2^w disjoint width-w point conjunctions has CE/I>=w/18. This last assertion also covers nonexchangeable reference rules; it does not exclude function-specific references or retained-KL corrections, and does not disprove FEI.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs, finite uniform cubes, standard physical influence
Entropy and ideal complete subprobability cross entropy in bits; natural logs explicitly ln
Product reference is on nonempty subsets and its actual nonempty spectral mass is retained
Influence-only rule gives the same reference for every Boolean realization with the same labeled influence vector and permitted invariant metadata
Coordinate permutation changes the function, while the equal-influence vector in the stated tribes family is unchanged
No claim that arbitrary conditional-edge references or function-specific spectral references have unbounded cost

review_records.scope: A001 v1 final all-dimensional tribes orbit obstruction CE/I>=w/18, including labeled nonexchangeable influence-only rules. Earlier activated-parity, product-prior and bent-majorant clauses are not independently accepted by this record.
review_records.method: Independent orbit minimax reconstruction, canonical pairing enumeration, character-sum versus Walsh and physical-edge checks, exact factorized binomial certificates
